sources.azimuth_deg: Viewing direction heading: -90 looks down the target line from behind the golfer, as the down_the_line view does.
sources.elevation_deg: Viewing direction elevation. -3 is flatter than the -8 of down_the_line, so the apex of a driver flight stays below the top of a 16:9 frame.
sources.default_distance_m: Camera distance from the look-at point. 7 m (down_the_line: 3.75 m) leaves the golfer about a third of the frame height and room for a flight that curves 30 degrees off line.
